JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Harmony
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: The patching library almost every code mod needs, JB Framework included.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: Load it first, above everything else.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: HugsLib
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: A shared library with settings, logging and update news for other mods.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Expanded Framework
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Expanded Framework: the shared code of every Vanilla Expanded mod, including the pipe network system (PipeSystem).
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: JB mods read VE pipe buildings through the framework's VE adapter and leave their networks alone.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Prepatcher
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Patches game code before Harmony runs, for mods that need new fields on vanilla classes.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: On RimWorld 1.7 (new runtime) it stops with "Not available on non-Mono runtime"; mods that require it do not work there.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: On 1.7 leave it out unless a mod states 1.7 support. JB mods never need it on 1.7.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Miscellaneous 'CORE'
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Miscellaneous 'CORE': shared code of Haplo's Misc. mods.
